svg.title: Issue 4 — Page 3 — Panel 1: Full squad tableau, Theodore's face in gap behind
svg.desc: 28mm wide. Wall cavity camp at fairy scale. All five squad members visible — Sable center HOLD fist, Jink frozen near gap, Thresh weapon up, Wren standing calculating, Luma scanner activating. Beyond, Theodore's enormous face fills the gap. Power cell glows on timber ledge, perimeter emitters pulse blue-white, equipment in rows. Two worlds meeting. Thresh: Contact.
